question: What solvent mixture, at what volume ratio, was used to extract the cubic lacustrine shale samples, and at what temperature and for how long?
expect: dichloromethane/methanol 93:7 (v/v), water bath at 40 °C for 14 days (fluid changed every 2-3 days) (sec. 2.2)
rendered: The solvent mixture used was dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol (MeOH) at a volume ratio of 93:7. The extraction was performed at a temperature of 40 °C for 14 days.
